title: Lawrence USD 497
text: Lawrence USD 497 is a public unified school district headquartered in Lawrence, Kansas, United States.  The district includes the communities of Lawrence (most), Clinton, Pleasant Grove, and nearby rural areas.  It was organized in 1965 and currently serves 11,427 students from pre-Kindergarten to grade 12 and maintains an early childhood center (pre-k), 13 elementary schools, four middle schools, two high schools, a K-12 virtual school, and an adult learning center.
